_comment: PLAN-CAPTURE-SAFETY P0-a — remote per-provider capture kill switch.
Deploy this as a STATIC file at the POLICY_URL in background.js:
https://policy.vodou.ai/capture-policy.json
The extension polls it on startup and every 12h. To disable capture for a
provider, set its capture to false and deploy — live installs stop capturing
there within 12h, with no Chrome Web Store review cycle.
This file is DATA, never logic. That distinction is what makes it legal under
MV3 (which bans remotely hosted CODE; Google's own guidance names remote JSON
feature flags as the permitted pattern). Do not add selectors, regexes, URLs,
adapter definitions or anything the extension would have to interpret — the
extension keeps only the capture booleans and ignores everything else, so
adding logic here would not work anyway, by design.
Keys are CAPTURE ADAPTER names (sites.js `capture`), not inject keys. Six
differ: lechat not mistral, t3chat not t3, youcom not you, duckai not duck,
huggingchat not huggingface, characterai not character.
capture:true is not a grant. The extension keeps only explicit false entries,
so a true here is dropped rather than applied — it can never re-enable a site
the user turned off themselves. Remote can only ever take away. The entries
below are written as true purely to document the full key set.
min_ext_version is advisory metadata only; nothing enforces it yet.
Serve with permissive CORS, no Set-Cookie, and a short cache TTL. The fetch
sends credentials:'omit' and no query string on purpose: this must not become
an install-tracking beacon, or 'captured data never touches Vodou
infrastructure' stops being true.
